scope: Private retrained final-module ablations: source-fit408 then adapt54, native160, fixed source reference16. full is the reused guided spatial M1/M2 + M3 endpoint; full_control is its matched CE+0.1KL continuation. no_m1/no_m2/no_m3 each use their OWN source-fit teacher, intervention selection and guided adaptation; plain uses its OWN teacher and CE+0.1KL, with no reference contribution. full-minus-plain includes architecture AND training-objective differences, not pure architecture. full_control-minus-plain matches the subsequent CE+KL objective, while source-fit objectives, architecture and own teachers still differ. Module deletion contrasts compare entire retrained procedures, not fixed-teacher causal effects. Before/after uses each arm's own source fit; only full/full_control share their before archive. Matched samples, initialization, permitted update range and step counts do NOT match parameter counts or FLOPs. The pre-save checks establish deletion of the disabled module's dedicated paths and losses; logits cannot establish this. Seeds17/29/43 vary training order with shared initialization, NOT independent initializations; CUDA is not strict deterministic. Receipt trainable counts and seconds are descriptive only: cache and machine-memory conditions differ, so no formal speed claim. Development160 and expanded3075 are historical, NOT blind tests; shared ports are not strict held-port evaluation. OA/BA are percent, paired deltas percentage points; BA uses present classes, natural-log NLL, sum-over-eight-class Brier. Sample SD is across order seeds. Pass bootstrap is conditional on these fixed models, not independent-training uncertainty. Repeated query/vessel/seed/reference exposure is not independent evidence. Intervals are descriptive, not multiplicity-adjusted. Native case selection is outcome-based, not prevalence; image-visible facts and physical mechanisms remain unreviewed.
